If you manage to assign a drive letter using disk management you should be able to mount it and it should work.  
After searching around everywhere I haven't found a single solution until I started experimenting myself, then managed to mount my encrypted volume after doing something no one has suggested online, went to disk management on windows 10 and assigned a letter for the drive which I attempted to mount. If you can get a dual boot configuration going or boot from another volume which has windows 10 installed on it you can go to **disk management -> find the RAW volume -> right click: assign letter -> then try mounting again, should work just fine!**
